newsitem.title: USA: GENTEX SHIPPING MIRRORS TO GM.
newsitem.headline: GENTEX SHIPPING MIRRORS TO GM.

text.p: Gentex Corp said Wednesday it began shipping three new night vision safety (NVS) mirrors for installation in General Motors Corp's 1998 Chevrolet and GMC Suburbans, and the GMC Yukon and Chevrolet Tahoe sport utility vehicles.
Gentex said the contract, which covers about 600,000 units, is valued at more than $10 million.
NVS mirrors automatically darken precisely to the level required to reduce glare from the headlights of vehicles approaching from the rear. The brighter the glare, the darker the mirrors become.

"This is one of the largest orders we have ever received for auto-dimming mirrors and our dollar content per vehicle will be the highest that Gentex has ever achieved on any one vehicle," said Gentex Executive Vice President Kenneth La Grand.
"Over 50 percent of the approximately 600,000 total units we expect to ship for these 1998 GM sport/utility vehicles are incremental units," he said in a news release.
Shares of Gentex were trading off 1/8 to 24-3/4.
